summary: Learn legal-pluralism mapping, referral design, safeguards, and case-flow tracking. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Legal pluralism training examines how customary forums and formal institutions handle disputes and coordinate referrals. It is designed for justice officials, legal professionals, and governance practitioners who map dispute pathways and connect resolution processes. Participants practise mandate mapping, consent and safeguard screening, referral-protocol design, and Excel-based case-flow tracking, including data-quality checks and human review of AI-assisted triage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, deliver, oversee, or connect customary and formal dispute-resolution pathways.
prerequisites: Familiarity with justice, governance, public administration, legal services, or community dispute resolution is useful. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel for the case-flow mapping exercise; no specialist software is required.
